text:
alex: heads-up: seeing a sustained p95 p99 spike for svc-infer in us-west starting ~16:04. spike correlates with a KV-cache saturation pattern on a subset of shards. opening thread.
maria: confirmed. profiler shows kernel selection thrash between int8-fast and fallback kernel; cost of kernel switch + kv miss storm seems to be the multiplier.
nate: noisy tenant? any big customers on these shards?
alex: yes: tenant-omega had a short lived traffic bump; tail of short-seq requests. KV cache hitrate dropped from 82% -> 41% on shard-12.
julia: dumping small trace and counters now. attaching snippet:
```
HOTKEYS: shard=12 tenant=omega
kv_hits=41234 kv_misses=58903
kernel_switches=8903 switch_cost_ms=1.7
batch_window_us=2500
```
srebot: Incident INC-4515 created by alex: latency_surge_us-west; severity=high; runbook=runtime-kvcache-hotkey
maria: immediate mitigation: can we enable tenant-level throttling + pin tenant-omega to isolated pool? if we can move to a dedicated pool we cut cold misses.
nate: can do tenant-throttle flag now. /flag set tenant_throttle.omega=rate:200rps
alex: flip kv-cache fallback policy -> aggressive-prefetch=false, kernel_switch_backoff=500ms for shard-12
julia: also suggest routing fallback to small-llm variant for shortseq noisy traffic: model=redwood-small-qa-v1 for tenant-omega/shortseq. less KV pressure.
maria: rolling change: 1) throttle tenant, 2) enable model fallback, 3) set kernel backoff. doing in that order.
srebot: deployment plan posted: roll 3 changeset ids: cs-9981, cs-9982, cs-9983. ETA 5m.
alex: i'll watch p95/p99 and eviction rate. if not improving in 10m we escalate to evict-probe and consider evicting large-kv-entries.
julia: putting a temporary alert override to avoid pager spam but keep dashboard updates.
maria: quick note - profiler shows a tight loop inside kernel selector in path X. follow-up ticket for a selector debounce will be filed after incident.

nate: p95 trending down after throttle + fallback :thumbsup:
alex: nice. p99 still noisy but improved 45%.
srebot: Incident INC-4515 updated: mitigation applied. monitoring for 30m before close.
maria: create postmortem stub and tag eng-runtime + eng-ml for kernel selector debounce work.
alex: thanks all. logging final perf dump to s3://redwood-infer/incident/1765432100/profile.pb and linking in the PM.
